notes: Inputs are existing synthetic recordings, not personal microphone audio.
First three attempts exposed a QA feeder bug and never reached assistant output. They are not failed conversational tests.
A zero-valued persistent source fixed silent RTP continuity; later cases use that QA-helper repair.
DOM sampling is irregular (roughly 120-170ms); it is not exact word alignment or 60fps motion measurement.
Correction sampling paused after a transient listening state; completionCheck and finalLifecycle prove a second reply completed, but its middle caption was not captured.
